title: glyceria fluitans var. notata
intro: Glyceria fluitans var. notata, commonly known as notated floating manna grass, is a type of aquatic grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been found to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Glyceria fluitans var. notata include its diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant are still being researched, but it is believed to contain glycerides, flavonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
